items.title: Available 24/7
items.body: Answer calls and messages during business hours, after hours, weekends, and holidays.

items.title: Natural Multilingual Conversations
items.body: Communicate naturally in English, Spanish, and French.

items.title: Intelligent Call Routing
items.body: Route by department, employee, location, language, campaign, caller intent, or urgency.

items.title: Fast, Controlled Setup
items.body: Train the AI using approved website content, documents, FAQs, policies, and call instructions.

items.title: Answer every incoming call
items.body: Use approved greetings and business-hour rules without leaving callers waiting.

items.title: Answer common questions
items.body: Respond from approved websites, documents, policies, services, and FAQs.

items.title: Capture and qualify leads
items.body: Ask configured questions and prepare complete lead context.

items.title: Book and reschedule appointments
items.body: Use approved calendar availability and scheduling rules.

items.title: Send confirmation messages
items.body: Confirm next steps through configured messaging channels.

items.title: Route calls with complete context
items.body: Transfer by intent, team, language, availability, or urgency.

items.title: Update Odoo CRM records
items.body: Queue approved lead and activity mappings through the secure backend.

items.title: Generate recordings and transcripts
items.body: Apply configurable consent and retention settings.

items.title: Monitor analytics and outcomes
items.body: Review sample call outcomes, questions, languages, and campaign attribution.

items.title: Escalate complex calls
items.body: Hand off safely when the AI reaches a restricted action or unknown answer.
